item.name: Glock
item.description: Loaded, under your jacket. You haven't had to use it in a long time, and you'd rather keep it that way.

item.name: Screen bracelet
item.description: Everyone wears one. Yours links you to the station, to the GAFAmedia and to a night that has only just begun.

item.name: Vodka flask
item.description: Commissioner K.'s totem of invincibility. Every swig counts, and the book counts them with you.
